summary: Frontend-only regression for My Wealth Media static site (iteration 2). Verified duplicate logo removal, new testimonial section, updated OG/Twitter/canonical meta + JSON-LD, image re-encoding integrity, and full regression on hero, layout, cursor, animations, and contact/footer. verified_checks.regression: PASS — h1 'Operations' is text (no , Italiana), no horizontal overflow at 1920x800 (scrollWidth=1920) or 390x844 (scrollWidth=390), body.has-cursor present with .cursor-dot and .cursor-ring, testimonial reveal animation triggers, mailto and Instagram links present, footer present
